name: opencode-state-machine
description: State machine library for OpenCode plugins — gives schema-based workflow with strict validation between steps

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && bun run build:tui && bun run build:schema && bun run build:decl && bun run build:verify
scripts.build:verify: bun -e "const { existsSync, readFileSync } = require('fs'); const required = ['dist/index.js', 'dist/tui.js', 'dist/index.d.ts', 'dist/tui.d.ts', 'dist/profile.schema.json', 'dist/profile-schema.schema.json']; const missing = required.filter(f => !existsSync(f)); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing build outputs:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } const idx = readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf-8'); const tui = readFileSync('dist/tui.js','utf-8'); if (idx === tui) { console.error('ERROR: dist/index.js and dist/tui.js are identical - one entrypoint overwrites the other'); process.exit(1); } console.error('Build verification: all outputs present, entrypoints distinct');"
scripts.build:schema: bun -e "import { ProfileMetadataJsonSchema } from './src/schema/profile-metadata.ts'; import { writeFileSync } from 'fs'; writeFileSync('dist/profile.schema.json', JSON.stringify(ProfileMetadataJsonSchema, null, 2));" && bun -e "import { ProfileSchemaJsonSchema } from './src/schema/profile-schema.ts'; import { writeFileSync } from 'fs'; writeFileSync('dist/profile-schema.schema.json', JSON.stringify(ProfileSchemaJsonSchema, null, 2));"
